data.one_liner: A wrapper around hive_ce for easy local data storage and encryption.
data.what_it_does: It wraps hive_ce and flutter_secure_storage to provide an easy interface for storing, encrypting, and caching local key-value data and custom models. It features per-box locks, custom box opening, and error recovery for corrupted boxes.
use_when: You need encrypted local storage or key-value caching in Flutter.
You want to manage custom typed models in Hive boxes with built-in encryption key management.
avoid_when: You require complex relational database queries or SQL support.
You need native multi-process database access.
strengths: Automatic encryption key storage via flutter_secure_storage
Per-box locks for improved write performance
Handles corrupted cache boxes automatically during initialization
weaknesses: Relies on Hive and requires code generation for complex custom objects
Breaking changes removed the built-0in session/token management in version 3.0.0
data.setup_notes: Initialize via LocalStorage.initialize(). Optionally use hive_ce_generator and build_runner for custom object adapters.

alternatives.name: hive
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the original Hive package instead of the community fork (hive_ce).

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: For simple key-value storage without heavy NoSQL setup.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a traditional SQLite relational database.
